content: OpenCost (CNCF, Apache-2.0, originally open-sourced by Kubecost): real-time cost allocation by cluster/node/namespace/controller/service/pod, dynamic on-demand k8s asset pricing via AWS/Azure/GCP billing API integrations, allocation for CPU/GPU/memory/PV, and exports pricing data to Prometheus via a /metrics endpoint. The Prometheus export is the key integration point: it lets cost become a first-class Grafana dashboard and even an alerting signal alongside RED/USE metrics, with no SaaS dependency and no per-node license.
